user.title: Connect to WAHA
user.description: Running WAHA as a Home Assistant add-on? The host is the add-on's hostname, shown on its info page — the slug with every underscore replaced by a hyphen, for example `a1b2c3d4-waha-whatsapp-api`. The API key is the add-on's `api_key` option.

data_description.session: Used by service calls that do not name a session of their own.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the WAHA API key
reauth_confirm.description: WAHA at {host} rejected the stored API key. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach WAHA. Check the host and port, and that the add-on is running.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from WAHA. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This WAHA server is already configured.
abort.wrong_server: Those settings point at a different WAHA server. Add it as a new entry instead.

entry_not_found.message: No WAHA configuration entry with ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The WAHA entry "{title}" is not loaded.

entry_id_required.message: More than one WAHA server is configured. Set config_entry_id to choose one.

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Sends a text message through WAHA.

config_entry_id.name: WAHA server
config_entry_id.description: Which WAHA server to send through. Optional while only one is configured.

chat_id.name: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Recipient. A channel looks like 120363000000000000@newsletter; a contact like 12025550100@c.us.

session.name: Session
session.description: WAHA session to send from. Defaults to the entry's session.

link_preview.name: Link preview
link_preview.description: Whether WhatsApp should render a preview for links in the message.

send_media.name: Send media
send_media.description: Sends an image, video, audio file or document by URL. WAHA downloads it itself, so the file never passes through Home Assistant.

config_entry_id.name: WAHA server
config_entry_id.description: Which WAHA server to send through. Optional while only one is configured.

chat_id.name: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Recipient. A channel looks like 120363000000000000@newsletter; a contact like 12025550100@c.us.

url.name: File URL
url.description: URL WAHA fetches the file from. It must be reachable from the WAHA container, not from your browser.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Name WhatsApp shows for the file.

mimetype.name: MIME type
mimetype.description: Chooses how the file is sent: image/* as a photo, video/* as a video, audio/* as a voice note (transcoded), anything else as a document.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Text shown with the file. Ignored for audio, which WhatsApp sends as a voice note with no caption.

session.name: Session
session.description: WAHA session to send from. Defaults to the entry's session.
